artworks.title: Jupiter and Io
artworks.description: Correggio's Vienna canvas — Zeus as a dark cloud embracing Io, the passion that begins her gadfly wander.

artworks.title: Mercury and Argus
artworks.description: Rubens' Prado scene — Hermes lulling hundred-eyed Argus so Io the heifer may escape Hera's watch.

artworks.title: Mercury and Argus
artworks.description: Velázquez's Prado fable — Argus already asleep as Mercury reaches for the sword, Io's prison about to open.

artworks.title: Io watched by Argus (Pompeii fresco)
artworks.description: Pompeian fresco — Io as white heifer under Argus' gaze, the wander still ahead across continents to Egypt.

artworks.title: The Myth of Io
artworks.description: Cassone panel cycling Io's story — transformation, Argus, and the long road that ends beside the Nile.
